description: Posted pay percentiles (25/50/75/90) for a title, place (default US) and optional seniority, with sample size and a short recommendation. Daily snapshot (see as_of). For live counts or who is hiring now, use count_jobs. Cells with fewer than 30 jobs are omitted. No account needed.

place.description: US (the default), a state code such as TX, a state name, or a city such as "Austin, TX" (cities only for lookup, breakdown and negotiate).

role.description: A standard job title such as "Registered Nurse" or "Software Engineer"; leave out for every job. Same as title.

seniority.description: intern, entry, senior, lead, manager, director or executive, read from the job title (lookup, breakdown, negotiate).

title.description: A standard job title; lookup, breakdown and negotiate match more than 6,000 titles. Same as role.

name: salary_range
title: Salary range for a role
